concerns.location: tasks.md:Revision behavior (scaffold-only drops) vs constitution.md:Reproducibility Requirements
concerns.text: Tasks drop the pinned `requirements.txt` as 'scaffold-only' claiming 'the platform supplies common packages', but the constitution explicitly requires 'A requirements.txt (or pyproject.toml) at projects/PROJ-975-.../code/ pins every Python dependency' and 'no global packages are assumed'. No task delivers this file. This is a constitution violation introduced by the task list, not a scaffold detail.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T004/T005/T007/T008 vs plan.md:Project Structure and data-model.md:Experiment Log
concerns.text: Tasks write/read the per-task log as `data/results/experiment_log.csv`, while plan.md and data-model.md name it `data/results/metrics.csv` (with plan.md's structure also listing a separate metrics.csv for aggregates). The tasks' choice is fine, but the plan/data-model were not reconciled; an implementer following plan.md Phase Ordering step 3-4 will produce a filename T008 never reads. Update plan.md/data-model.md to match.

T007 runs a three-arm pruning sweep (off / FR-004 / redundancy variant), but plan.md specifies '2 pruning flags' and never mentions the redundancy variant. The variant does not weaken FR-004 (which T006 implements verbatim — good), but the plan-level experimental design was not updated to authorize the third arm; record it in plan.md so the sweep is not an undocumented scope change.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T010 vs contracts/metrics.schema.yaml:breakpoint_estimate and plan.md:Primary Tipping-Point Selection
concerns.text: metrics.schema.yaml requires a `breakpoint_estimate` per (library_size, pruning_enabled) group, but plan.md/T008 define a single primary breakpoint from the baseline configuration only. T010's verification ('aggregated metrics file validates against metrics.schema.yaml') forces a per-group value with no defined derivation rule, risking either fabricated per-group numbers or schema failure. Specify how per-group breakpoint_estimate is computed (e.g., supplemental per-group PLR fits) or reconcile the schema.
